name: ShinyLaunch

sources.title: ShinyLaunch homepage — daily product launches with weekly voting
ShinyLaunch submit — 'Log in to Submit', Google auth gate

requirements: Account required — /submit redirects to a login screen; sign-in is via Google (account creation at /signup)
Every product is submitted by its creator and reviewed before going live
Products join a weekly lineup; new voting cycle starts each Monday
preparation: Product name, tagline/description, logo, category (broad taxonomy incl. Dev Tools, AI Assistants, SaaS-style categories), pricing-model tag (Free/Paid/Freemium/Free Trial)
workflow: Log in with Google (or create an account)
Wait for review — approved products join the weekly lineup
Community voting runs through the week; top products become weekly 'winners' in the hall of fame
watchFor: Submit page is a hard auth wall — nothing about form fields is visible without logging in
Homepage and submit page carry ads for a third-party 'submit to 140+ directories' service (submitsaas.com) — not a ShinyLaunch upsell
FAQ says submissions are free and 'reviewed promptly' but gives no SLA
countsAsLive: The product appears in the Latest feed / weekly lineup with its own detail page and vote count.
unknowns: Exact form fields and asset requirements (behind Google auth)
Whether any paid tier exists — no pricing page was visible
